sections.footer: Two heavy channels, 842 live creatives — one of the deepest software paid programs we've torn down. The gap isn't the ads — it's which of them actually becomes a paying team in your own CRM, correlated across Google intent and every LinkedIn touch and acted on daily. That's the layer Northstar Analytics owns.

cards.title: 'CRM for Agencies' converts to paid at 2.6× the blended rate — but gets 4% of the budget
cards.found: Vertical-intent terms (Agencies, Deal Management) convert trials to paid teams at 2.6× your generic 'CRM' terms, yet the long-tail category creatives still absorb most of the spend.
cards.why: Those long-tail terms haven't lifted paid conversion in 90 days — budget is anchored to volume, not to the terms that actually become paying teams.
cards.move: Shift 20% of generic-category budget to the vertical-intent terms, point them at intent-matched pages, and add the zero-paid long-tail terms as negatives.

cards.title: 23 ICP workspaces signed up from Google, hit the data-model setup, and stalled — none routed
cards.found: Over 14 days, 23 workspaces matching your best paying-team profile signed up from paid search, reached the import/data-model step, and went quiet.
cards.why: This is the exact pattern before 4 of your last 6 sales-assisted wins — high-fit accounts stalling at the one step that predicts expansion.
cards.move: Route the 9 largest workspaces to sales today as a named list, and enroll the rest in an activation nurture keyed to the data-model step they stalled on.
cards.impact: Recoverable expansion & paid conversion this quarter
